description: Morphe patches for Kim Launcher (com.kimkim) 1.0.2789: settings-only in-app updates, always free plan.

patches.name: Always free plan (skip subscription check)
patches.description: Stops Kim Launcher asking its server about the subscription: every check immediately stores and returns the free plan. Paid (Trial/PRO) features stay locked, even if the car has a subscription.

patches.name: Settings-only in-app updates
patches.description: Shows a newer upstream version only in the settings screen: no automatic update check or popup on the main screen, and updates are never downloaded or installed (the upstream update is signed differently and cannot install over a patched build).

release_notes:
- Target Kim Launcher 1.0.2789+401 (API v2); 1.0.2787 dropped
- In-app updates: no automatic check or main-screen popup; new version still visible in settings; never downloads or installs (renamed 'Settings-only in-app updates')
